name: Emberbutt
ability: Flame Body / Flash Fire / White Smoke (hidden)
look: a little cigarette-butt creature: papery white body, orange filter rear, an ash ring and a glowing ember nose
entry: It feeds on dry paper and dry leaves to keep the tip of its snout glowing. If extinguished, it falls into a deep, sluggish sleep.
how: Wild: common in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Cherry Flick at level 9.
